description: VS Code settings for Claude customization on Modular RAG Framework.

PostToolUse.description: Lint Python code after any file write. Checks for syntax (E), undefined names (F), and import order (I).

permissions.description: Permission model for Claude development on this project. Balances safety (protecting core architecture) with velocity (open tests/examples).

denylists.reason: Secrets management - environment variables, API keys, credentials
Local configuration files with personal preferences
Production configs - V4 scope, locked until governance ready
Architecture rules - breaking changes impact entire framework

allowlists.reason: Domain module - safe to extend with new chunkers, parsers, processors
Domain module - safe to extend with new retrievers, rerankers
Domain module - safe to extend with new generators, prompts
Evaluation module - safe to add metrics, scorers
Memory module - safe for conversation/context management
Test scope - creating tests is encouraged; full refactoring allowed
Example scenarios - safe sandbox for demonstrations
Documentation - safe to add guides, ADRs, updates

restrictedPaths.reason: Protocol definitions - breaking changes impact entire framework
Registry + wiring logic - central to component composition
allowedChanges: new routing logic within existing pattern

restrictedPaths.reason: Safety/Security critical - PII redaction, prompt injection guards, policies
Embedding adapters - Protocol implementations for embeddings
Vector store adapters - Protocol implementations for persistence

futureHooks.description: Reserved for V2+ validation patterns. Uncomment when ready to enable.

PostToolUse.description: RESERVED: Detect cross-domain imports (e.g., retrieval/ importing from generation/)
RESERVED: Verify Protocol implementations have conformance tests
RESERVED: Check that lazy imports are used for heavy deps

notes.ruffConfig: Ruff settings use defaults (see pyproject.toml for customization).
notes.permissionsModel: defaultMode='auto' respects the permission layers: denylists (block entirely), allowlists (full access), restrictedPaths (ask before edit). Protects core architecture while remaining open for domain extensions, tests, and examples.
notes.denylists: Blocks V2+ reserved namespaces (adapters/llms, adapters/auth, adapters/graphstores, adapters/search) to prevent premature implementation before V1 completion.
notes.restrictedPaths: Requires 'ask_before_edit' for Protocols (breaking impact), Registry wiring (central), Security (safety-critical), and Adapter implementations.
notes.bypassPermissions: Always set to false. This is the exact governance pattern you want to enforce.
notes.futureValidation: To enable import cross-domain detection in V2+, set 'enabled': true in futureHooks and ensure scripts/ directory exists.
notes.moreInfo: See .claude/.instructions.md, .claude/rules/*.md, and CLAUDE.md block 09 for full guidelines.
